summary: Split the 1,080-line PairingScreen out of MainActivity.kt into android/app/src/main/java/zenpi/ui/ (AppShell, WorkspaceTabs, ConversationSection, ApprovalCard, TerminalSection, dialogs/{Browser,Session,Reader,Workspace}Dialogs) driven by grouped PairingActions interfaces instead of ~60 lambdas; MainActivity now binds a ViewModelActions adapter. PairingState is composed of 12 sub-states (ConnectionState, WorkspaceState, DiffState, TerminalHistoryState, TranscriptState, WorkerHistoryState, WorkerStatusesState, FilesState, ResourcesState, ModelState, SessionsState, SessionHistoryState) while keeping the flat constructor/accessors/copy and structural equality, so policies and tests are unchanged. Fixed: the invite countdown only ticks while an invitation is live (InviteTicker) and is read only by the phase label/invite section; composer drafts are keyed by host, session and tab ids (DraftKey) without the subtab revision.

notes: PairingScreen(...lambdas) is kept as a thin adapter in zenpi.ui for the instrumentation suites; androidTest files only gained `import zenpi.ui.PairingScreen`, except SessionScopeScreenTest whose two assertions encoded the old wipe-on-revision behaviour (now asserts the draft survives the revision bump and the unsent message draft returns after the run ends). Draft semantics: message and task drafts use DraftKey(host, project/session, tab); a draft the user submitted is cleared when the host acknowledges it (the former key change: active message id / subtab revision), text typed but not sent survives. Steering text stays scoped to the run it steers (DraftKey + active request id) so it never carries over to another run, matching the existing steering assertions. UI-local dialog state keeps its previous keys. Not done: emulator recomposition count and instrumentation execution; ZE-519 Roborazzi goldens will cover rendering.
